title: pvFLASHAMRParticlesReader
body:
## pvFLASHAMRParticlesReader

Reads particles from a FLASH HDF5 checkpoint or plot file into a multiblock dataset of polydata particle points with the selected particle arrays. Frequency keeps every N-th particle and FilterLocation keeps only particles inside a box. Use pvFlashReader for the grid fields of the same FLASH output.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- MaxLocation is the upper corner of the filter box, although ParaView's own documentation calls it the minimum.
- Schemaxis generates this binding from ParaView's catalogue; it has not run a native acceptance check for this operation.

Native constructor: `FLASHAMRParticlesReader`. Identity: `sources/FlashParticlesReader`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

No connected inputs (source/resource).


### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `FileNames` | The list of files to be read by the reader. Fixed at construction; cannot vary per visit. | `{"items":{"minLength":1,"type":"string"},"minItems":1,"type":"array"}` | `required` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |
| `FilterLocation` | Turns on filtering of particles by location | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `false` |
| `Frequency` | This property sets the frequency interval for loading particles. | `{"type":"integer"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `1` |
| `MaxLocation` | Upper corner [x, y, z] of the axis-aligned box used when FilterLocation is true: particles with any coordinate above it (or below MinLocation) are dropped. Coordinates are in the file's units. ParaView's own documentation calls this the minimum location; the reader uses it as the maximum. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `MinLocation` | This property sets the minimum 3-D coordinate location by which the particles will be filtered out. | `{"items":{"type":"number"},"maxItems":3,"minItems":3,"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `[1,1,1]` |
| `ParticleArrayStatus` | Names of the particle arrays to read (for example particle_mass or velocity components); unlisted arrays are skipped, saving memory and time. Positions are always read. | `{"items":{"type":"string"},"type":"array"}` | `native initialisation / omitted` | `["REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"]` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

Coverage and unbound native properties:

```json
{
  "defaults": "native defaults for omitted options",
  "gaps": {},
  "origin": "generated",
  "output": "native inspection required; explicit output-port selection available",
  "outputPorts": null,
  "qualification": "not-run"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "pvFLASHAMRParticlesReader",
  "options": {
    "FileNames": [
      "REPLACE_WITH_VALUE"
    ]
  }
}
```
